entities.summary: Beijo (Uh-La-La) is a song by Romanian music group Morandi from the album Reverse released on April 28, 2005, during the MTV Romania Music Awards ceremony. The song's lyrics are sung in Portuguese. The song was a popular summer hit in Romania in 2005, and in July of that year, reached number 1 on the MTV Europe and World Chart Express charts, overtaking singles by Coldplay, U2 and Shakira.
